newsitem.title: USA: Dow higher at start of trade.
newsitem.headline: Dow higher at start of trade.

text.p: The Dow industrials were higher at the start of trade on Tuesday following an uptick in the bond market and some follow through to Monday's late rally.
The Dow Industrials index was up eight at 6,963. The Nasdaq Composite was up three at 1,282, while the S&P Index was off fractionally at 796
As Wall Street opened the 30-year long bond was up 3/32 to yield 6.95 percent.
